doc.searchinput_scenario_list: [MISSING_TRANSLATION: pt] Search placed at the top of a table or list for item extraction.

doc.switch_best_practice_2: [MISSING_TRANSLATION: pt] Label the Switch with a noun phrase describing the feature being toggled (e.g., 'Dark mode'), not a verb phrase like 'Enable dark mode'.
